note: Set A binds the Table 4-1 values correctly (E=200E11 Pa, G=7.93E10 Pa, rho=7.85E3 kg/m3, Gs=140E6 Pa) and captures the hub height, 10-m monopile diameter, 30-m clearance, 100-t transition piece and 0.170 Hz mode, but it repeats several claims and gives two mutually contradictory, chart-inconsistent 1P ranges (0.09–0.13 Hz and 0.12–0.25 Hz) plus an invented 'steady-state' condition. Set B adds the soil Poisson's ratio of 0.4 that A misses, but it misreads table entries (785E3 kg/m^5, 785E3 kg/m^3, 793E3 Pa), reports 0.18 Hz alongside 0.17/0.170 Hz, and includes vague or misbound claims such as 'ground | height | 30 m' and 'Tower | Shear modulus, soil'. Overall A has fewer outright wrong or unsupported claims despite its duplication.
